**Where defined:**

- Granted via `grantStartingEquipment(db, id, body.class)` called from `createCharacter()` (`character.ts:60`).
- Item IDs resolve against rows inserted in `worker/src/db/seed.sql` (sequential insert order): `2`=Longsword, `15`=Shield, `17`=Potion of Healing, `23`=Torchx5.

Also documented in `docs/flows/character-creation.md` (class/item table) and `worker/src/db/seed.md`.
